title: Stop the recurring regressions
brief: Claude keeps reintroducing an old customer-code format and removing a cache, even after those changes were corrected. Several tasks appeared fixed, but the next session repeats the mistakes. Find and fix the cause, then demonstrate that a new session completes the next task correctly.
acceptance: A new session preserves the current customer-code contract and required caching.
The diagnosis explains the recurring cause and cites repository evidence.
The correction preserves useful project guidance and avoids a blanket deletion.
Authorization and the full suite remain correct.
